استنجبوا (form X)
# اِسْتَنْجَبُوا (istanjabū) /is.tan.d͡ʒa.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَنْجَبَ (istanjaba)
# اُسْتُنْجِبُوا (ustunjibū) /us.tun.d͡ʒi.buː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَنْجَبَ (istanjaba)
# اِسْتَنْجِبُوا (istanjibū) /is.tan.d͡ʒi.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَنْجَبَ (istanjaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
